subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use the right preposition after adjectives (good at, keen on ...).

tf.s: A lazy person doesn't like working.

tf.why: Interested always goes with 'in': interested in technology.

tf.s: A confident person believes they can do things well.
tf.why: Confident people trust their own abilities.

tf.s: A shy person loves talking to new people.
tf.why: A shy person feels nervous with new people; a sociable person enjoys them.

tf.s: 'Fed up with' means very happy with something.
tf.why: 'Fed up with' means bored or annoyed with something.

tf.s: After 'terrible at' we use the -ing form, like 'terrible at drawing'.
tf.why: A preposition is followed by a noun or an -ing verb.
Rude is negative: it means not polite.

tf.s: A sociable person enjoys being with other people.
tf.why: Sociable people like meeting and talking to others.

tf.s: Someone who makes you laugh is serious.
tf.why: Someone who makes you laugh is funny.

boxes.q: Complete: I'm fed up ___ this song.
Najla doesn't often joke or smile. She's ...
boxes.why: A person who rarely jokes is serious.

boxes.q: Which adjective means 'making a lot of sound'?
boxes.why: Noisy people or places make a lot of sound.

boxes.q: Which adjective describes someone who loves sport?
Complete: My brother is brilliant ___ maths.
boxes.why: We say brilliant at, like good at.

boxes.q: Which word is the opposite of 'noisy'?
boxes.why: A calm person is quiet and relaxed.

mcq.q: Which adjective describes someone who is not nice or friendly?

mcq.why: We say terrible at, like good at.

o: Words that often go together, like keen on
A question with yes or no

mcq.q: Correct the mistake: 'I'm interested on technology.'
Ali gets top marks and solves problems quickly. Which adjective fits him?
mcq.why: Clever means good at learning and thinking.

mcq.q: Which sentence describes a friend fairly and kindly?
o: My friend is clever and he's brilliant at maths.
My friend is lazy and rude.
My friend is unpleasant at everything.
My friend is noisy on everything.
mcq.why: Describing people fairly means avoiding unkind labels.

mcq.q: Why is 'Are you good at drawing?' correct but 'Are you good in drawing?' is not?
Fahad loves parties and talks to everyone. His brother stays quiet with new people. Which pair of adjectives fits them?
mcq.why: Fahad enjoys people, so he is sociable; his brother is shy.
